title: Petrobras seeks oil exploration operations in Ghana
seoTitle: Petrobras seeks oil exploration in Ghana
subtitle: The Brazilian giant demonstrates interest in expanding its operations on the African continent
excerpt: Petrobras announces interest in oil exploration in Ghana, reinforcing its presence in Africa.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Petrobras announced this Friday its interest in engaging in oil exploration in Ghana, a country of approximately 35 million people.

The announcement indicates a potential expansion of the company's activities on the African continent.

With information from Agência Brasil.
